summary.intent: Push the portal watcher and download command to the team repo, verify the Gmail app password, email supplier Boise Semiconductor to resolve a delivery-terms discrepancy and assess launch impact, then build a versioned change-summary dashboard that reruns periodically and is exposed through a Cloudflare tunnel from ada.
summary.outcome: Pushed the watcher and download command to main (760772f) after a rebase. Verified Gmail SMTP/IMAP and sent EXW confirmation threads to Boise, which released the 36,000 cards. Built change-summary and dashboard modules, set up an ask-soony Cloudflare tunnel and committed the work in two commits. The Karton Nowak art book order and the analysis of the 16:57 drop remain pending.

repo: Team workflow in PROGRESS.md and AGENTS.md is 'pull --rebase, push' directly to main, with no branches or PRs; PROGRESS.md 'Now' section is the usual conflict spot.
Entire's git hook pushes checkpoints and needs extra time during commits.
Portal data, outbox/inbox mail and local findings notes are gitignored (data/outbox/<message-id>.json, data/inbox/*.eml).
Supplier replies are threaded via In-Reply-To matching our message ID, and arrive in about 3-4 minutes, apparently from automated agents. All suppliers share the domain suppliers.juliansibbing.de.
Gmail app password spaces are only display formatting; the mail code should strip them. The Sent folder has a German name ('Gesendet') on this account.
Soony's SAP POs say DDP Hamburg while Boise's contract (§4.1) says EXW, so the PO is wrong. The shipment list shows 'booked' for a waybill that was actually on hold.
dashboard.py and store.py are exempt from the line-length lint rule because of HTML/CSS strings.

code.finding: New module that summarizes file-version changes without AI: CSV row/column diffs, Excel cell diffs per sheet, line diffs for text/PDF/Word. Column rename detection compares values only on rows present in both versions, because added rows break length-based comparison.

workflow: Gmail app passwords can be checked for SMTP and IMAP login without printing the secret.
Long-running waits for supplier replies work well as background commands with task notifications.
QUIC/UDP is blocked on the hackathon Wi-Fi, so cloudflared needed --protocol http2 (TCP 443).
Existing tunnels (lampy-dev, mcphub) were left untouched and a separate ask-soony tunnel with its own config was created.

friction: Column-rename detection test failed when rows were also added; the logic had to be rewritten.
Cloudflare tunnel over QUIC failed on the venue network and had to be restarted over HTTP/2; DNS record had to be repointed to the new tunnel.
Lint failures on long HTML/CSS lines in dashboard.py required a lint exemption.
No self-service portal or database at the supplier to verify agreed values.
The 16:57 data drop is downloaded but not analysed by the agent without an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
open_items: Decide on and send the Karton Nowak order for 8,000 art books (Polish plus English), which closes the 5,900 Collector's art book gap.
Statue lot sorting needs sign-off from Clara Weiss and Daniel Okafor (internal decision).
Container pickup of 350,000 card cases at the Hamburg terminal by Sunday morning (internal logistics).
Correct delivery terms on all open Boise POs in SAP from DDP to EXW.
Await Boise's flight details and freight, insurance and duty amounts.
Build the mail part into the watcher: outbox approval, IMAP inbox, reply-to-thread matching and a supplier address allowlist.
Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env so the agent can draft mail and add AI summaries on top of the diffs.
Run the watcher on ada as background services; the confidential data and token would live on a university machine, which needs the user's go-ahead.
Dashboard is protected by a password in .env; the tunnel hostname was switched and needs a final check.
Turn the Boise EXW/booked-vs-on-hold contradiction into an agent test case and note it in the findings.
